correctness.rationale: For the specified synchronous rule with boundary 0, triangular recovery makes the prefix maps permutations. Lifting a cycle of length L reduces its extensions to cycles of the time-ordered return permutation on the last symbol. The independently reproduced prefixes have profiles 3; 9; 27; 27,27,27. In particular, the three consecutive nine-symbol monodromies over the triple orbit have image tuples (2,0,1), (0,1,2), and (1,2,0), so their ordered composition is the identity. Fresh enumeration checks the 27-step return on all 81 states and the partition into three cycles. Projection onto four coordinates commutes with the dynamics, so inverse images of distinct cycles are nonempty invariant clopen sets; this proves nontransitivity and nonminimality on the full one-sided space. It does not establish the orbit structure within those sets. Correctness refers to the stated permutations; the primary-source table caption and candidate numbering were not independently verified.
